name: Blinded
summary: Can't see; auto-fail sight checks; attacks have disadvantage; attacks against have advantage.

name: Charmed
summary: Can't attack charmer; charmer has advantage on social checks against you.

name: Frightened
summary: Disadvantage on ability checks and attacks while source is in line of sight; can't willingly move closer.

name: Grappled
summary: Speed becomes 0; can't benefit from speed bonuses.

name: Invisible
summary: Heavily obscured for others; attacks have advantage; attacks against have disadvantage.

name: Paralyzed
summary: Incapacitated; can't move or speak; auto-fail Str/Dex saves; attacks have advantage; hits within 5 ft. are critical if attacker is within 5 ft.

name: Petrified
summary: Incapacitated; resistant to all damage; immune to poison and disease.

name: Poisoned
summary: Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

name: Prone
summary: Melee attacks against have advantage; ranged have disadvantage; your attacks have disadvantage.

name: Restrained
summary: Speed 0; disadvantage on attacks and Dex saves; attacks against have advantage.

name: Stunned
summary: Incapacitated; can't move; can speak only falteringly; auto-fail Str/Dex saves; attacks against have advantage.

name: Unconscious
summary: Incapacitated; can't move or speak; drops held items; falls prone; auto-fail Str/Dex saves; attacks have advantage; hits within 5 ft. are critical.
